column1: # Environmental radiogenic gamma line list for the Phase-4 Compton channel (Plan 04-02).
# DOCUMENTED TUNABLE INPUT -- every intensity/flux row carries provenance + an uncertainty band.
# Guards fp-invented-flux: NO per-line flux is assigned from memory.
# WHAT IS FIXED NUCLEAR DATA (HIGH confidence):
#   * energy_keV            -- line energy
#   * p_gamma               -- gamma emission probability per PARENT decay
#                             DDEP/LNHB evaluated decay data (per-decay yield).
# WHAT IS SOURCED / SITE-DEPENDENT (MEDIUM confidence
#   * flux_cm2_s            -- absolute per-line flux [cm^-2 s^-1]. Absolute
#                             normalization ANCHORED to a cited measured spectrum:
#                             LABChico environmental gamma survey (Eur. Phys. J.
#                             Plus
#                             208Tl 2614.5 keV = 0.0016 cm^-2 s^-1 (as recorded in
#                             GPD/phases/04-.../4-RESEARCH.md
#                             Heusser
#                             the canonical review context (ref-environmental-gamma).
# HOW SIBLING LINES ARE SET (documented
#   * Th-232 chain: sibling 208Tl lines scaled from the measured 208Tl 2614.5 keV
#     anchor by the DDEP intra-chain emission-probability ratio; 228Ac lines by the
#     228Ac/208Tl cross-emitter ratio (232Th->208Tl alpha branch b=0.3594
#     equilibrium). "Th-232-decay-equivalent flux" Phi_Th = 4.463e-3 cm^-2 s^-1.
#   * U-238 chain: NO directly cited line flux was available. DOCUMENTED ASSUMPTION
#     (flux_source=assume_U_eq_Th): 238U-chain decay activity ~ 232Th-chain
#     Phi_U = Phi_Th = 4.463e-3; 214Bi/214Pb line fluxes = Phi_U * p_gamma. Carries a
#     factor-~2 (flux_unc_frac=1.0) band -- this is the weakest anchor (see
#     uncertainty_markers). Tune Phi_U to re-normalize the U-chain edges.
# Integral flux of these DISCRETE lines = 0.0485 cm^-2 s^-1
# environmental flux (0.1-0.5 cm^-2 s^-1 underground per LNGS/LABChico/HPGe surveys;
